description: This file defines the ImpactItemProjectForm class, a form processor for managing impact items related to a project, including form creation and saving functionality.

classes.name: ImpactItemProjectForm
classes.description: A form processor for creating and managing impact item project forms, including fetching impact items, building the form, and saving data.

methods.name: getImpactItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of impact items based on impact data option, formatted for form choices.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Returns whether the impact item field should be read-only based on the model's impact item.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form for impact item project data input.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates, extracts, and saves form data into the model, throwing exceptions on errors.
